subject: RetailX pilot connector kickoff — integration playbook & owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Miller <jmiller@retailx.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@finops.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: RetailX pilot connector kickoff — integration playbook & owners

Hi John / Elaine —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight playbook so we can lock the pilot scope and start engineering work next week. Please review and confirm the items below by EOD Thursday so we can set the kickoff call.

Call highlights (from our discovery):
- Goal: surface real-time product recommendations in cart using RetailX event stream + Redwood inference for reranking/formatting.
- Success metrics: relevant CTR uplift, p95 latency < 200ms for inference layer, and inference cost < $0.015/request.
- Data: RetailX will provide a 30GB sample event history + live event stream (Kafka) during the pilot.
- Security: RetailX needs SOC 2 evidence and a brief network diagram for VPC peering.

Proposed pilot (two parts):
1) Integration window (2 weeks): wire SDK routes -> streaming (ingest) -> inference route -> validation harness.
2) Evaluation window (3 weeks): run live traffic to evaluate success criteria and measure cost/latency.

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood PM / kickoff: Marissa Cole (I'll own the schedule & rollout)
- Integration lead (SDK / API surface): Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.ai)
- RetailX engineering lead: John Miller
- Security/compliance contact: Elaine Park

Key implementation notes (high level):
- We recommend using Redwood streaming inference with prefix+KV caching for recommendation reranks.
- Primary API route: POST /v1/inference/cart-rerank (streaming responses supported).
- We'll deliver a sample openapi + YAML with route examples and a minimal SDK usage snippet (attached).

Attachments: retailx-poc-overview.pdf, redwood-poc-api-sample.yaml

Please confirm: (1) alignment on success metrics above, (2) who owns the security questionnaire, and (3) availability for an engineering kickoff call on Tue Feb 21 (10–11 PT) or Wed Feb 22 (morning PT).

Thanks —
Marissa

Hi all —

Quick engineering notes based on the proposed scope:

1) API surface and SDK: we'll provide the following minimal endpoints for the pilot (examples in attached YAML):
   - POST /v1/inference/cart-rerank (streaming response) — primary
   - POST /v1/embeddings/batch (batch-only) — for offline evaluation
   - GET /v1/models/list — to enumerate allowed model variants (for cost control)

   Example SDK snippet (node):
   const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
   // streaming rerank
   await client.stream('/v1/inference/cart-rerank', { body: events, onChunk: handleChunk });

2) Streaming / caching: recommend enabling prefix-based KV cache for product title prefixes to reduce token cost on repeated SKUs. We'll configure default cache TTL to 30 minutes for the pilot.

3) Test harness / metrics: engineering will instrument with token-level latency and cost breakdowns; we'll export p50/p95/p99 latency and total cost per 10k requests to the drive folder.

4) Timeline (engineering rough):
   - Day 0–2: credentials exchange + access to test Kafka topics
   - Day 3–7: implement route + sample SDK integration + basic smoke tests
   - Day 8–14: end-to-end validation with sample event replay + perf sweep

5) Blockers: need test Kafka credentials + a staging API key from RetailX.

Happy to pair with John/engineers on the initial integration.

—Ben

POC action list (owners & due dates):
- RetailX: provide test Kafka topics + staging API key — owner: John Miller — due: 2028-02-17
- RetailX: complete security questionnaire & upload SOC 2 evidence — owner: Elaine Park — due: 2028-02-18
- Redwood: deliver sample SDK + API YAML + caching defaults — owner: Ben Carter — due: 2028-02-16 (attached: redwood-poc-api-sample.yaml)
- Redwood: instrument perf metrics & cost telemetry for trial — owner: Rachel Kim — due: 2028-02-25
- All: engineering kickoff video call — Wed 2028-02-21 10:00–11:00 PT — calendar invite sent

Attachments: poc-success-criteria.md (defines pass/fail gates), redwood-poc-api-sample.yaml

Acceptance criteria summary (from poc-success-criteria.md):
- Functional: end-to-end rerank pipeline able to process 200 req/s sustained with <350ms p99 during evaluation window.
- Quality: CTR uplift >= 6% over baseline sample set.
- Cost: token cost per inference <= $0.015 averaged over evaluation runs.

Next steps for John/ELAINE: please upload the security artifacts and confirm test topic credentials by 17/18 Feb. If any of those dates slip we'll re-evaluate the kickoff.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the kickoff.

—Marissa
